Continuously monitors the supply to appliances and cuts power if an earth current fault is detected, protecting against the risk of fatal electric shock. When set, retains closed contacts if mains supply is interrupted, with no need to reset after a loss of power. Ideal for appliances such as fridge freezers. Fitted with twin earth, and integrated RCD to prevent electrical current leakage. Manufactured from rugged, scratch-resistant metal with multiple knockouts. Ideal for commercial and industrial environments.
